statement: The United States military conducts at least one strike on a target located on Iranian land territory, including Iranian islands, between 2026-10-26 and 2026-11-15 inclusive.
resolution: Between 2026-10-26 and 2026-11-15 inclusive, US Central Command, the Pentagon or the White House confirms, or two of Reuters, AP, AFP and BBC independently report, a US strike on a target on Iranian land.
failure_condition: No US military strike on a target on Iranian land territory occurred between 2026-10-26 and 2026-11-15 inclusive.

statement: A single Russian missile or drone attack on one Ukrainian city kills at least 20 people between 2026-10-26 and 2026-11-15 inclusive.
resolution: By the deadline, Ukrainian officials and two of Reuters, AP, AFP and BBC report a confirmed death toll of at least 20 from one Russian strike on one Ukrainian city occurring between 2026-10-26 and 2026-11-15 inclusive.
failure_condition: No single Russian strike on one Ukrainian city between 2026-10-26 and 2026-11-15 inclusive killed 20 or more people.

statement: ICE front-month Brent crude futures settle at or above 125.00 dollars per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-10-26 and 2026-11-13 inclusive. Reference: 111.70 dollars per barrel on the packet date.
resolution: ICE Futures Europe daily settlement price of the front-month Brent contract is 125.00 dollars or higher on any trading day between 2026-10-26 and 2026-11-13 inclusive. Reference: 111.70 dollars on the packet date.
failure_condition: The ICE front-month Brent settlement stayed below 125.00 dollars per barrel on every trading day between 2026-10-26 and 2026-11-13 inclusive.

statement: At least one of S&P Global Ratings, Fitch Ratings or Moodys Ratings lowers the long-term sovereign credit rating of France by one or more notches between 2026-10-26 and 2026-12-11 inclusive.
resolution: S&P Global Ratings, Fitch Ratings or Moodys Ratings publishes a rating action between 2026-10-26 and 2026-12-11 inclusive lowering the long-term sovereign rating of France by at least one notch; outlook changes alone do not count.
failure_condition: None of S&P Global, Fitch or Moodys lowered the long-term sovereign rating of France by a notch between 2026-10-26 and 2026-12-11 inclusive.

statement: The CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog adds at least one vulnerability in the PHP language runtime, with a date-added value between 2026-10-26 and 2026-11-08 inclusive.
resolution: The CISA KEV catalog JSON carries at least one entry with a dateAdded value between 2026-10-26 and 2026-11-08 inclusive whose vendorProject is PHP Group or whose product is PHP.
failure_condition: CISA added no PHP vulnerability to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog with a dateAdded value between 2026-10-26 and 2026-11-08 inclusive.

statement: Jordanian security forces arrest or kill at least one suspect in the church funeral shooting in Jordan that was reported on 2026-10-24, between 2026-10-24 and 2026-11-07 inclusive.
resolution: Between 2026-10-24 and 2026-11-07 inclusive, Jordanian officials confirm the arrest or killing of at least one suspect in the church shooting, and two of Reuters, AP, AFP and BBC report it.
failure_condition: Jordanian security forces neither arrested nor killed any suspect in the church funeral shooting between 2026-10-24 and 2026-11-07 inclusive.

statement: At least one earthquake of magnitude 7.0 or greater occurs anywhere on Earth between 2026-10-25 and 2026-11-02 inclusive, by UTC origin time.
resolution: The USGS earthquake catalog lists at least one event of magnitude 7.0 or greater with origin time between 2026-10-25 and 2026-11-02 inclusive (UTC), using the magnitude shown at the deadline.
failure_condition: No earthquake of magnitude 7.0 or greater had a UTC origin time between 2026-10-25 and 2026-11-02 inclusive.

statement: A laboratory-confirmed Ebola case is identified in a country that had reported no confirmed Ebola case in 2026 before 2026-10-24, between 2026-10-26 and 2026-11-15 inclusive, excluding patients medically evacuated from abroad.
resolution: Between 2026-10-26 and 2026-11-15 inclusive, WHO or a national health ministry reports a laboratory-confirmed Ebola case in a country with no confirmed Ebola case in 2026 before 2026-10-24, excluding medically evacuated patients.
failure_condition: No country that had zero confirmed Ebola cases in 2026 before 2026-10-24 identified a laboratory-confirmed case, other than a medically evacuated patient, between 2026-10-26 and 2026-11-15 inclusive.

statement: The Democratic Party wins at least 218 of the 435 seats in the United States House of Representatives in the general election held on 2026-11-03.
resolution: By the deadline, the Associated Press has projected, or Clerk of the House results show, Democrats winning at least 218 House seats in the 2026-11-03 general election.
failure_condition: Democrats win fewer than 218 of the 435 House seats in the 2026-11-03 general election.

statement: The French government falls, meaning the Prime Minister in office on 2026-10-24 submits a resignation of the government accepted by the President, or the National Assembly adopts a censure motion against it, between 2026-10-26 and 2026-12-11 inclusive.
resolution: Between 2026-10-26 and 2026-12-11 inclusive, the Elysee announces acceptance of the government resignation, or the National Assembly adopts a censure motion against it, per the Journal Officiel or Assemblee nationale records.
failure_condition: The French government neither had its resignation accepted by the President nor lost an adopted censure motion between 2026-10-26 and 2026-12-11 inclusive.
